description: Improvements to LAMMPS input file generation module based on LAMMPS_MODULE_IMPROVEMENTS.md

features.description: Fix charge style fails with JSON structures
features.issue: When using atom_style 'charge', code fails with plain JSON structures because it expects pymatgen objects with oxidation_state attribute
steps: Create get_charge helper function that handles both pymatgen objects and plain dicts
Check isinstance(species, dict) and use species.get('oxidation_state', 0.0)
Update extract_structure_info function to use new helper

features.description: Fix non-contiguous fixed atoms group definition
features.issue: When fixing more than 10 atoms, code uses 'id start:end' syntax which only works for contiguous atoms
steps: Write fixed atom IDs in chunks of 20 per group command
Use 'group mobile subtract all fixed' to create mobile group

features.issue: No validation of pair_coeff syntax or parameter consistency with selected pair_style
steps: Update API endpoint to run validation

features.description: Frontend offline mode triclinic cell support
features.issue: The gen_lammps_local() function only handles orthogonal cells, not triclinic cells with tilt factors
steps: Add getBoxBounds function matching backend implementation
Calculate xy, xz, yz tilt factors
Update data file generation with tilt factors

features.issue: No unit consistency checks for timestep vs units
steps: Warn if timestep > 0.01 ps for metal units
Warn if timestep > 1.0 fs for real units
Suggest lj units for lj/cut pair_style

features.issue: Users must manually specify pair_coeff for common potentials
steps: Add API endpoint to list templates
Update frontend to show template options

features.issue: Users must manually configure common simulation types
steps: Define presets: bulk relaxation, surface annealing, defect migration, thermal expansion
Allow user to override preset values

features.issue: Generic error messages don't help users fix issues
steps: Include expected format in error response
Show received value that failed validation

features.issue: Only atomic and charge styles supported
steps: Add molecular style for molecules with bonds
Add full style for molecular systems with charges
Add angle style for angle-dependent potentials
Update backend to handle bonds/angles data

features.issue: Dump format is hardcoded, users can't choose
steps: Include options: atom, custom, xyz, cfg
Pass selected format to generation function

features.issue: Different LAMMPS versions have different syntax
steps: Add default version to latest stable

features.issue: No way to validate without generating files
steps: Don't generate files if validation fails
